Declare

Begin
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nAccess from valid_user_access_classes where
 user_id=lt_user_session.get_userid and access_class='ULOCK' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+2);

 Else

 End if;
 Else

 END If;
END;

declare

 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 05/29/2011. IM 5706
 select a.donor_id, a.donation_type, a.procedure_code,
 InitCap(b.last_name)||', '||InitCap(b.First_name)
 into :online_status.donor_id, :online_status.c_don_type, :online_status.c_proc_code,
 :online_status.name 
 from donations a, donors b
 where a.transaction_id = :online_status.transaction_id 
 and a.donor_id = b.donor_id;
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/29/2011. IM 5706
 begin
 select a.donor_id, a.donation_type, a.procedure_code
 into t_donor_id, :online_status.c_don_type, :online_status.c_proc_code
 from donations a
 where a.transaction_id = :online_status.transaction_id;

 t_donor_id := null;
 :online_status.c_don_type := null;
 :online_status.c_proc_code := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if :online_status.donor_id is not null or t_donor_id is not null then
 if :online_status.donor_id is null then
 :online_status.donor_id := t_donor_id;
 end if;
 
 begin
 select InitCap(last_name)||', '||InitCap(First_name)
 into :online_status.name
 from donors
 where donor_id = nvl(:online_status.donor_id, t_donor_id);
 exception

 :online_status.name := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE

 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALCULATE_TOTALS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE calculate_totals IS
 nHHCount NUMBER:=0;
 nPFCount NUMBER:=0;
 nPHCount NUMBER:=0;
 nTotal NUMBER:=0;
 nPCount NUMBER:=0;
 nDCount NUMBER:=0;
 nCCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 go_block('online_status');
 first_record;
IF :online_status.name is not null then 
 Loop
 nTotal:=nTotal+1;

 IF :online_status.status_flag!='D' then 

 if :online_status.HLTH_HIST_end is null then
 nHHCount:=nHHCount+1;
 end if;

 if :online_status.PHY_FINDINGS_end is null then
 nPFCount:=nPFCount+1;
 end if;

 if :online_status.PHELOB_END is null then 
 nPHCount:=nPHCount+1;
 end if;

 End if;

 if :online_status.status_flag='C' then 
 nCCount:=nCCount+1;
 end if;

 if :online_status.status_flag='P' then 
 nPCount:=nPCount+1;
 end if;

 if :online_status.status_flag='D' then 
 nDCount:=nDCount+1;
 end if; 

 if :SYSTEM.last_record='TRUE' then 
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;


 End loop;
 first_record;
 :ctrl_blk_1.hlt_count:=nHHCount;
 :ctrl_blk_1.phy_count:=nPFCount;
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_count:=nPHCount;

 :ctrl_blk_1.tot_F:=nCCount;
 :ctrl_blk_1.tot_P:=nPCount;
 :ctrl_blk_1.tot_D:=nDCount;
 :ctrl_blk_1.C_QUERY_COUNT:=nTotal;

END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :online_status.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 if lower(p_window_name) in (lower('DCWDCOMM'), lower('DPWDEMGR')) then
 -- this program needs user id for insert record
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_insert_user', TEXT_PARAMETER, :banner.user_id); 
 end if;
 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 synchronize;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVE_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select dr.drive_id, to_char(dr.drive_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'), substr(InitCap(sp.name), 1,50) Spname 
from drives dr, drive_sponsors drs, sponsors sp 
where dr.drive_id = drs.drive_id 
and drs.sponsor_id = sp.sponsor_id 
and ((:ctrl_blk_1.drive_date is not null and drive_date=:ctrl_blk_1.drive_date)
or (:ctrl_blk_1.drive_date is null and drive_date between (trunc(sysdate)-:ctrl_blk_1.lov_limit) and trunc(sysdate)))
and dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
and dr.status = 'CNFRM'
order by drive_date desc
